program.name: Advisory program
program.note: Tiered annual fee on assets in the program, billed quarterly; no trade commissions.

lower_cost.name: Advisory program: index-only portfolio
lower_cost.note: Lower fee with fewer services (no SMA managers or custom tax management); advisor compensation differs from the full program.

brokerage.note: Commission on each trade (illustrative full-service rate) plus the funds' own expenses, including sales loads and 12b-1 fees.

strategies.name: CIO Model Portfolio (ETF)
strategies.desc: Low-cost funds that follow the CIO strategic allocation and tactical views for the client's profile.

strategies.name: Core Equity Direct Indexing
strategies.desc: Owns the index companies directly, harvests losses to offset gains, and can exclude a concentrated stock and tilt away from its sector.

strategies.name: Tax-Managed Large Cap SMA
strategies.desc: Actively managed large-cap portfolio that takes in existing stocks and sells them over time within a gain budget.

strategies.name: Large Cap Value SMA
strategies.desc: Quality value companies with growing dividends.

strategies.name: International Equity SMA
strategies.desc: Developed and emerging markets companies, actively managed.

strategies.name: Municipal Ladder SMA
strategies.desc: Individual high-grade municipal bonds laddered over 1 to 10 years; tax-exempt income.

strategies.name: Dividend Income Model
strategies.desc: Funds tilted to dividends and interest for clients who want income.

strategies.name: Alternative Investments Platform
strategies.desc: Hedge fund and private equity access for qualified clients; limited liquidity.

henderson:NVDA.note: Wants to give shares to the grandchildren's trust in 2026.

kaplan:AAPL.restricted: Employee: pre-clearance and quarterly trading windows apply. A pre-arranged sale plan lets sales continue through closed windows.
kaplan:AAPL.note: RSUs from 12 years at the company; retiring in 18 months.

brennan:NVDA.restricted: Employee: shares vest quarterly; trading only in open windows.
brennan:NVDA.note: Saving for a home down payment in 2027.

delgado:COST.restricted: Employee: pre-clearance required; quarterly trading windows.
delgado:COST.note: Company stock from 25 years of employee purchase plans.

solutions.name: Staged sale in brokerage
solutions.desc: Sell the highest-basis lots first, each tax year within the gain budget.

solutions.name: Tax-managed SMA through the tax-efficient transition
solutions.desc: Move the shares in kind; the manager sells them down over time and builds a diversified portfolio around them.

solutions.name: Direct indexing with the stock excluded
solutions.desc: Harvested losses offset the gains from trimming; the index sleeve excludes the stock and leans away from its sector.

solutions.name: Gift low-basis lots
solutions.desc: Give the lowest-basis shares to family or a donor-advised fund; removes the embedded gain from the client's tax return.

solutions.name: Protect with a collar or exchange fund (specialist referral)
solutions.desc: Keeps the shares but limits downside, or swaps them into a diversified pool; arranged by the capital markets specialists.

segments.low: Low: cash, fixed income and C shares, with low embedded gains
segments.medium: Medium: some embedded gains or share-class constraints
segments.hard: Hard: taxable with high embedded gains, A shares or clients aged 80 and over

pathway.note: Illustrative thresholds for the prototype; production uses the approved screen thresholds.
